convert_bits_to_bytes: convert a binary bitstream string to bytes and return the number of padded bits
convert_bytes_to_bits: convert bytes data back to a binary bitstream string accounting for padded bits
right_shift_bytes_by_one: right-shift all bytes in data by one bit to divide by two while preserving structure
zero_most_significant_bit_if_not_ascii_d: zero the most significant bit of non-ASCII bytes to ensure ASCII decodability
normalize_pdf_for_arithmetic_coding: normalize probability distributions for arithmetic coding to avoid numerical issues
